new_entities.name: OverdraftReview
new_entities.description: Records the full lifecycle of an annual overdraft facility review for a personal customer account. Each review is a discrete audit record covering credit assessment, behavioural analysis, persistent debt screening, and the renewal/modification/withdrawal decision. Owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core, CAP-001). Introduced by JRN-016.

fields.name: review_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK -> ENT-004 (Account). The account whose overdraft facility is under review. Immutable.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK -> ENT-001 (Customer). Denormalised for audit query efficiency. Immutable.

fields.name: review_period_start
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Start of the review period (typically current_expiry_date - 365 days). Immutable.

fields.name: review_period_end
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). End of review period (= current overdraft_expiry_date). Immutable.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: initiated | assessing | assessed | decided | notified | closed | deferred. Forward-only state machine. deferred is a temporary state when credit bureau is unavailable.

fields.name: initiated_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Set at batch trigger. Immutable.

fields.name: previous_overdraft_limit
fields.validation_rule: Required. The overdraft limit before this review. GBP. Max 2dp. Captured at initiation for audit comparison.

fields.name: previous_overdraft_apr
fields.validation_rule: Required. The overdraft APR before this review. Percentage. Max 2dp.

fields.name: credit_bureau_score
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set at PH-084. Credit bureau score from Experian/Equifax/TransUnion. Integer 0-999 (Experian scale). Null if bureau unavailable.

fields.name: credit_bureau_refresh_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of credit bureau data refresh.

fields.name: credit_grade
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Enum: A | B | C | D | E | F. Internal credit grade derived from bureau score and internal behavioural data. Set by SVC-012.

fields.name: affordability_score
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Decimal 0.0-1.0. Affordability assessment score from SVC-012 combining bureau data and account behavioural analysis.

fields.name: avg_monthly_credit_turnover
fields.validation_rule: Required. Average monthly credit turnover (income proxy) over the review period. GBP. Max 2dp. Calculated from transaction history.

computed_from.logic: Sum of all credit transactions in review period / number of months

fields.name: overdraft_utilisation_days
fields.validation_rule: Required. Number of days the account was in overdraft during the review period. Integer 0-365.

computed_from.logic: Count of days where end-of-day balance < 0

fields.name: missed_payment_count
fields.validation_rule: Required. Count of direct debit or standing order bounces due to insufficient funds (including overdraft) during review period. Integer >= 0.

fields.name: persistent_debt_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: none | 18_month_trigger | 36_month_trigger. Determined at PH-085. FCA CONC 6.7 criteria: customer paid more in interest/charges than principal repayment over trailing 18 months.

fields.name: interest_paid_18m
fields.validation_rule: Required. Total overdraft interest and charges paid by customer over trailing 18 months. GBP. Max 2dp.

computed_from.logic: Sum of all overdraft interest debits and overdraft-related charges in trailing 18-month window

fields.name: principal_repaid_18m
fields.validation_rule: Required. Net reduction in overdraft borrowing over trailing 18 months. GBP. Max 2dp. Can be negative if borrowing increased.

fields.name: decision
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status >= decided. Enum: renew | modify | withdraw | suspend. Set at PH-086.

fields.name: new_overdraft_limit
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set when decision IN (renew, modify). GBP. Max 2dp. The new overdraft limit after review.

fields.name: new_overdraft_apr
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set when decision IN (renew, modify). Percentage. Max 2dp. The new APR after review.

fields.name: new_expiry_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when decision IN (renew, modify). ISO 8601. Typically review_period_end + 365 days.

fields.name: withdrawal_effective_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when decision = withdraw. ISO 8601. Must be >= decision_date + 30 days (30-day notice period).

fields.name: decision_rationale
fields.validation_rule: Required. Free text or structured rationale for the review decision. Consumer Duty outcome evidence. Max 1000 chars.

fields.name: consumer_duty_fair_value_assessment
fields.validation_rule: Required. Evidence that the overdraft product delivers fair value to this customer. Includes comparison of interest cost to account benefit. Max 2000 chars.

fields.name: decided_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status = decided.

fields.name: notified_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when customer notification dispatched.

fields.name: manual_review_required
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default false. Set to true when automated decision is borderline and requires PER-052 (Credit Analyst) review.

fields.name: manual_review_analyst_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when manual_review_required = true and review is completed. Analyst identifier.

fields.name: deferred_until
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set when status = deferred (credit bureau unavailable). ISO 8601. Typically initiated_at + 7 days.

relationships.description: OverdraftReview belongs to one Account. Multiple reviews per account over time (annual cycle).
OverdraftReview belongs to one Customer (denormalised from Account for audit query efficiency).

design_decisions.decision: OverdraftReview is a separate entity from Account (ENT-004).
design_decisions.rationale: Each annual review is a discrete audit record. Embedding review history in the Account entity would create unbounded nested arrays. Separate entity enables indexed queries by review period, persistent debt status, and decision type for regulatory reporting.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Customer
referenced_existing_entities.usage: Customer identity. customer_id referenced on OverdraftReview (ENT-054) for audit trail.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Account
referenced_existing_entities.usage: The account whose overdraft facility is under review. overdraft_limit, overdraft_apr, overdraft_expiry_date, and overdraft_facility_status are read and potentially updated by the review outcome.

new_fields.name: overdraft_facility_status
new_fields.validation_rule: Required for accounts with overdraft. Enum: active | suspended | withdrawn | pending_review. Default: active. Updated by JRN-016 review outcome.

new_fields.name: overdraft_limit
new_fields.validation_rule: Conditional. GBP. Max 2dp. The current authorised overdraft limit. Updated by JRN-016 review outcome.

new_fields.name: overdraft_apr
new_fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Percentage. Max 2dp. Single APR per FCA PS19/16. Updated by JRN-016 review outcome.

new_fields.name: overdraft_expiry_date
new_fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601. Date when current overdraft facility expires and review is due.

new_fields.name: persistent_debt_months
new_fields.validation_rule: Required for accounts with overdraft. Default 0. Cumulative months in persistent debt. Reset to 0 when customer exits persistent debt. Used for 18/36-month trigger determination.
